title: SlothDigest
description: Canonical schema for SlothDigest data: messages, conversations and digests. Bump 'version' on any breaking change and log it in COORDINATION.md.

Platform.description: Chat platform a message or conversation came from. Official export/API ingestion only.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: A single parsed chat message. 'id' is the SlothDigest-assigned ID used for attribution (AGENTS.md 7.4).

id.description: Stable ID (e.g. 'wa:conv1:000123') used by the LLM to reference this message.

sender.description: Display name or phone placeholder as parsed from the export; never decided by the LLM.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp converted from the export's local time.

text.description: Message body. Media placeholders like '<Media omitted>' are kept as-is.

reply_to.description: ID of the message this one replies to, if known.

is_system.description: True for system lines (encryption notices, join/leave, security changes).

participants.description: Observed senders. Ground truth for the attribution rule (7.4).

NeedsYouItem.title: NeedsYouItem
NeedsYouItem.description: Something that needs the user's attention, ranked by score.py. 'from' is rebuilt from stored messages by validate.py; the LLM never decides it.

message_id.description: Must point to an existing Message id, else the item is dropped by validate.py.

from.description: Sender, overwritten from the source message by validate.py.

reason.description: Why this needs the user: direct question, mention, deadline, VIP sender, etc.

suggested_reply.description: Draft reply suggestion. Draft only; SlothDigest never sends anything.

message_ids.description: IDs of supporting messages. Non-existent IDs cause the item to be dropped by validate.py.

PersonPoints.title: PersonPoints
PersonPoints.description: What one participant said or did in the window. 'name' must be a participant of the conversation.

when.description: Best-effort normalized date/time (ISO-8601 full or partial, e.g. '2026-03-14' or '18:30').

GroupDigest.title: GroupDigest
GroupDigest.description: Digest of one group conversation over the window.

message_count.description: Non-system messages considered in the window.

skipped_count.description: Messages judged banter/noise and not surfaced; shown in UI as 'Skipped (N messages)'.

model.description: Model used, from SLOTH_MODEL config (e.g. 'gemma3:4b', or 'fake' in tests).

prompt_version.description: Version string of the prompt files in backend/app/llm/prompts/.
